win.speaker: narrator
win.text: The second interceptor comes apart in your sights. Brann whoops. Someone in the back starts laughing and can't stop.

loss.speaker: narrator
loss.text: An interceptor gets close enough to burn a line along the Petrel's spine before your fire drives it off. The hull holds.

out.speaker: narrator
out.text: The Cinder Wake shrinks behind you, a dark seed against Haldis's amber disc.
